snippet.title: Necrowave - Official Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description:
Experience the emotional life of a zombie with his butt stuck in a microwave. It's a 2D platformer with critical thinking based combat where each different enemy feels like a puzzle to solve instead of relying on brute hack & slash tactics.
Head over to Steam and add Necrowave to your Wishlist.
